brief_rationale: The model systematically satisfied all responsibility-chain items without a single in-chain error. It completed three high-order points—HO1 (privacy-sensitive viral hepatitis discovery), HO2 (executable cross-institution record packet), and HO3 (dynamic reprioritization when new lab/emergency information emerged)—each with meaningful trajectory impact. No important non-chain defect was present. Closure is safe, executable, traceable, and valid. The trajectory therefore meets the strict criteria for Grade 5 Perfect.

The family demonstrates understanding and confirms the plan is in motion.
